title: Generic browser window
depicts: An unbranded browser window: address bar (tapped: https:// shown so the S can be zoomed), page, connection panel.

urlbar.label: the address bar
urlbar.physical: the field showing the web address

urlbar.host.label: the site name
urlbar.host.physical: the domain; stays visible to the network even with HTTPS

popover.label: the connection panel
popover.physical: connection details: protocol, site, who vouches for it, expiry

popover.issuer.label: who vouches for the site
popover.issuer.physical: the issuer: the certificate authority that signed the site's certificate

urlbar.scheme.label: https://
urlbar.scheme.physical: the scheme part of the address

urlbar.schemeS.label: the S of https
urlbar.schemeS.physical: the letter s: secure — the trip to the site is sealed with TLS

caveats: generic chrome: not any real browser's look (D1 #2d)
issuer in the connection panel is generic ('a certificate authority', D1 #2c)
